//: Copy to config.json (same folder) or ~/.config/opencode-widget/config.json. Every field is optional.
//apiKey: Leave empty to auto-detect from your opencode install (env, auth.json, or the opencode v2 database).
//authToken: Optional shared secret. If set, the page and API require ?token=... (the browser remembers it). Leave empty for an open LAN service.
//cacheSeconds: Server-side cache TTL. Keep it short (15-30s) or the widget will trail the web console. It only exists to collapse bursts from several devices.
//clientRefreshSeconds: How often the web page re-fetches from this server.
//endpoint: Override only if OpenCode changes the usage route.
